blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements per Zscaler cloud for the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. Zscaler will email a notification to your organization's registered support contacts approximately one week before your cloud is upgraded. To see scheduled maintenance updates for your cloud, visit the Trust Portal.

blocks.item: Adds a notification template that consolidates existing end user notification settings, and adds the ability to create and assign templates per app profile. To learn more, see Configuring Notification Templates for Zscaler Client Connector.

Adds user notification settings to control how End User Notifications (EUNs) from Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) are displayed for users. To learn more, see Configuring Notification Templates for Zscaler Client Connector.

Adds options to automatically start packet captures on Windows devices for specific scenarios such as tunnel failures and health checks. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Removes the Imprivata integration requirement for the Additional IdP Domains option. To learn more, see Using WebView2 Authentication.

Adds an option to have Zscaler Client Connector identify the system proxy manually on Windows devices instead of using the default Microsoft Windows APIs. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Adds an option to require the Default PAC URL to use the https:// prefix (not http://), and to not fall back to HTTP if the HTTPS download of the default PAC file fails. To learn more, see Enforcing Secure PAC URLs.

Adds an option to enable OAuth 2.0 machine tunnel authentication to require Authentication Service users to authenticate using an external device before the machine tunnel starts. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Adds a Policy Based Access (All Ports) option to the traffic forwarding actions for ZIA Disaster Recovery so you can forward traffic using Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds an option to monitor system proxy settings and re-cache them if Zscaler Client Connector detects changes. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Enables Zscaler Client Connector to steer traffic and manage endpoint firewall rules based on the user’s network type (e.g., On-Trusted or Off-Trusted). To learn more, see About Location-Based Policies.

Adds the ability to enter a customizable notification for end users who are blocked from a Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) app due to a failed device posture, and adds the ability to control displaying the notification per app profile. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles and Configuring a Notification Template for Zscaler Client Connector.
Adds an option to use location services on the user’s device to find the nearest data center. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds an app profile option to select the default language for the Zscaler Client Connector app. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds local packet capture enablement to the app profile in addition to the existing global packet capture enablement. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds a device posture check for specific Zscaler Client Connector versions. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles.
Adds an option to disable iCloud Private Relay in App Profiles. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Adds automatic ZPA reauthentication settings to the app profile that can override the global setting and can be applied based on a user’s network environment (e.g, On-Trusted or Off-Trusted). To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds options to require and generate passwords when disabling ZIA and Digital Experience (ZDX) remotely via CLI. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Updates the Registered Devices tab on the Client Connector App Store page to include devices for Authentication Service tenants.
Adds options to test Business Continuity mode with a group of users. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Adds a forwarding profile option to automatically switch to a TLS connection if the Z-Tunnel 2.0 DTLS connection becomes unstable. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
Updates the Zscaler SSL root certificate to add the security compliance with stricter validation rules (e.g., for Python 3.13.).

Updates the Browser-Based Authentication field for macOS in Platform Settings to an Authentication Browser Type drop-down menu with existing Default and Browser-Based Authentication options and a new WebAuthn Popup Browser option to use with Authentication Service. To learn more, see About Platform Settings.

Adds an Authentication Browser Type drop-down menu to app profiles for macOS that can override the global setting on the Platform Settings page. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Adds a global App Supportability setting to enable or disable Zscaler Client Connector Telemetry that, if disabled, automatically disables the Zscaler Client Connector Telemetry setting on app profiles. To learn more, see Enabling Zscaler Client Connector Telemetry.

Supports changing the calculation basis for the device count in the Registered Devices column on the Client Connector App Store page from Unique-ID to the Hardware Fingerprint. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Client Connector App Store.
Adds an option to control whether the VPN Gateway Bypass includes FQDN subdomains for Z-Tunnel 1.0 and Tunnel with Local Proxy. To learn more, see Bypassing FQDN Subdomains for VPN Gateway Bypass.
Fixes an issue where proxy auto-configuration (PAC) fails to download when a custom PAC URL with a trailing blank space is added to the forwarding profile.
Fixes an issue where users were unable to copy existing lists in the App Profile.

New endpoints are added to extend programmatic access for managing Zscaler Client Connector application and forwarding profiles. These endpoints allow you to retrieve or update application profiles, process-based applications, predefined IP-based applications, and custom IP-based applications. To learn more, see the API & Developer Reference Guide.

Adds a Search function that can be used during the adding or editing of an app profile to locate configuration items in the app profile policy window. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Addresses a vulnerability in the SAML authentication process to prevent session hijacking.

Adds a Reconnect Tunnel on System Wakeup feature to App Profiles, allowing Zscaler Client Connector to immediately restart Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0 after a macOS device wakes up from sleep. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Fixes an issue where the MAC Address in the Zscaler Client Connector Registered Device Details window was blank for Authentication Service users.
Fixes an issue where the Dynamic ZPA Service Edge Assignment field did not display the minimum required version numbers.
Updates the Health Metrics field names to Zscaler Client Connector Telemetry field names.
Fixes an issue where the Force Remove option was available for devices that were already unregistered.
Fixes an issue where the Custom DR PAC URL field in the App Profile configuration did not accept some URLs as input, and caused an unexpected validation error.

Updates the Zscaler Client Connector Device Details window to refresh the one-time passwords (OTPs) automatically every 60 minutes while the window is open, and adds a Refresh Status option in the Compliance Status section. To learn more, see Viewing Device Fingerprint for an Enrolled Device.

Adds app profile options for using Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0 on devices using Zscaler Client Connector for Android and for Android on ChromeOS. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Updates the Zscaler Client Connector Portal to support one-time passwords (OTPs) for devices belonging to Authentication Service users.

Fixes an issue where the Device Management page was blank and displayed a No Data Found message after clicking the graph to view devices with unsupported versions of Zscaler Client Connector in the Version Distribution widget on the Platform Details page.

Updates the Upload File feature in the VPN Gateway Bypass section of App Profiles to allow both comma-delimited (CSV) and delimited text (TXT) file formats. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Removes unnecessary elements in the log events that were created when a user accessed the Zscaler Client Connector Portal from the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Admin Portal from the audit logs to prevent problems when sending the logs to a security information and event management (SIEM) solution.
Fixes a Server is not responding error that could occur on the Update Settings tab of the Client Connector App Store page.

Fixes an issue where users could not enroll in a Zscaler service assigned to the device group that contains the user’s device in Authentication Service because the device posture Unique Device Identifier (UDID) for the device group was not sent to Authentication Service.
Fixes a timeout issue that occurred when exporting device fingerprint information from the Device Management page.

Adds a Device Events dashboard that displays Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) service status and statistics about users turning off the services via passwords. To learn more, see Understanding the Zscaler Client Connector Dashboard.
Adds the Zscaler Client Connector Telemetry option in App Profiles for Linux. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Supports a new endpoint in the Zscaler Client Connector API to download or export the Disable Reasons report under enrolled devices. To learn more, see the API & Developer Reference Guide.

Adds a Device Upgrade Status section to the Zscaler Client Connector Registered Device Details window that displays the status of an in-progress upgrade. To learn more, see Viewing Device Fingerprint for an Enrolled Device.
Updates the Zscaler Client Connector Registered Device Details window to display Service Status information for Authentication Service tenants.
Updates the Zscaler Client Connector Portal to support using device groups with app profiles for Authentication Service users.
Fixes an issue where tooltips did not stay open when users hovered over the tooltip, so users could not click a URL for more information.
Updates forwarding profiles to retain the existing values in the Advanced Z-Tunnel Configuration section if users switch from a Primary Transport Selection of DTLS to TLS or vice versa.
Fixes an issue where admin users with read-write access to the Zscaler Management Portal for Partners were granted read-only access after cross-launching into the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.

Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector Portal did not push the correct policy configuration to the client upon login by a Authentication Service user, resulting in the Data Protection service not appearing in the client application until the user manually updated policy in the More window.

Fixes an issue where a device group could not be deleted and a Device Group is already in use by Zscaler Service Entitlement message displayed instead, even though the device group was not associated with any service entitlements.
Fixes an issue where a success message displayed when a user tried to delete a predefined trusted network that was still associated with a Zscaler service.
Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector Registered Device Details window displayed the numerical value for the Device Trust Level instead of Low, Medium, High, or Unknown.
Fixes an issue where devices continued to be displayed on the Failed Posture Devices page for a device posture that had been deleted and wasn't referenced in any policy.
Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector didn't detect a known VPN as a trusted network due to the VPN network adapter list being cleared.
Fixes an issue where the Predefined Trusted Network Criteria value switched to None when copying a forwarding profile, even though the profile being copied had a value of Selected.

Fixes issues with the Device Posture dashboard where, after selecting Clear All in the Top 10 Failed Posture Profiles section, users received an application message if they selected any of the checkboxes next to the profiles.
Adds the Execute GPO Update option to the None mode in forwarding profiles. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.

Adds an option to allow Zscaler to retrieve and analyze Zscaler Client Connector log bundles to expedite resolution of customer-reported issues and to proactively resolve internal issues. Zscaler recommends enabling this feature. To learn more, see Enabling Auto System Info and Log Fetch.

Adds the ability to download a Digital Experience (ZDX) Module for Windows upgrade package that you can deploy with the Mobile Device Management (MDM) used by your organization or with the CLI. To learn more, see Viewing and Configuring ZDX Module Upgrades.

Adds options to have Zscaler Client Connector fail close when users experience a driver error or an FW/AV error and updates the Lockdown on Tunnel Process Exit option to include tunnel crashes and the Repair App option. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.

Adds options to improve certificate prompt handling in Zscaler Client Connector to enhance user experience and reduce prompt frequency. To learn more, see Using WebView2 Authentication and Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds a setting to restrict Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) partner logins to specify which partner tenants can access your organization’s tenant. To learn more, see Enabling ZPA Partner Logins.
Adds an option to control screen focus for notifications from the Zscaler Notification Framework. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds a Use Tunnel SDK Version 4.3 option to support new features introduced with Zscaler Client Connector version 4.3 for iOS. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Adds an option to control Transparent Proxy-Based Traffic for Zscaler Client Connector for macOS. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles.
Updates the MTU for Zscaler Adapter field to require a valid value to prevent an error that occurred when saving a forwarding profile after clearing the field.
Updates the Install WFP Driver feature to clear the values in dependent fields (e.g., Flow Logging and Process-Based Application Bypass) when you disable the feature.
Fixes an issue where accessing the Zscaler Client Connector Portal resulted in a blank page due to browser caching issues.
Fixes an issue where the Failed Posture Devices page loaded slowly if there were no postures to display.
Updates the User Groups drop-down menus in Zscaler Service Entitlement to accept a hashtag or pound sign (#) in the Search field.
Updates the Force ZPA Reauthentication field to display the associated Zscaler Client Connector version for each drop-down menu option.

Supports application bypasses for Microsoft 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop to bypass traffic for Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0. As a result, customers no longer experience a 30- to 60-second connectivity loss when launching or exiting Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see Adding IP-Based Applications to Bypass Traffic.

Adds the ability for users to select their preferred language in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal including German, Japanese, Spanish, French, and Simplified Chinese. To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
Supports configurable posture check intervals for macOS devices. To learn more, see About Device Posture Profiles and Configuring Device Posture Profiles.
Fixes an issue where the base filenames in CSV file exports of some enrolled devices included the '.' character.
Fixes an issue where enabling device groups for Android caused service entitlements to be disabled for Windows and macOS configured with posture-based entitlements.
Fixes a pagination issue on the Device Management page for devices enrolled in Authentication Service.

Fixes an issue where, within a few minutes after enabling access, the partner tenant disappeared from the Notifications window of Zscaler Client Connector Portal, and the ZPA service disconnected when running on Zscaler Client Connector version 4.6.0.123.
